description: Audit a lookup table against its contract. The finding that matters most: one source mapping to several targets, because a lookup built from it is not a function and whichever row is read last wins. Also reports required sources that are unmapped, so anything carrying them falls through, targets outside the permitted set, and - when a one-to-one mapping is declared - a target reached from several sources. Pay 120000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

csv.description: The mapping table. Delimited text with a header row, at most 262144 bytes and 5000 data rows. RFC 4180 quoting is honoured. Nothing is fetched.
csv.example:
country,region
AU,APAC
NZ,APAC
GB,EMEA
GB,UK
IE,
US,AMER

delimiter.description: Single field separator. Defaults to a comma.

expect_injective.description: Report a target reached from more than one source. Defaults to false, since many-to-one is usually intended.

permitted_targets.description: The only values a mapping may produce. A permitted target nothing maps to is reported too, since handling for it is never reached.

required_sources.description: Values that must be mapped. Each one absent is a finding and the coverage rate is reported.

name: mapping_contract_audit

ambiguous_source_count.description: Sources mapping to more than one target, which makes the lookup not a function.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of the data was not, which is a different problem from data that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

row.description: 1-based and counting the header, so it matches a text editor.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

valid.description: True only when the table was fully read, every required source was mapped, every target was permitted, and no source was ambiguous.

title: Mapping Contract Audit
